code:
services:
  web:
    depends_on: [api]
  api:
    depends_on: [db]
    environment: {DB_HOST: db}
  db:
    image: postgres:16
caption: Three services, three containers, one compose.yaml -- web, api, and db wired together.

code:
$ docker compose up -d
[+] Running 4/4
 ✔ Network ch06_default  Created
 ✔ Container ch06-db-1   Started
 ✔ Container ch06-api-1  Started
 ✔ Container ch06-web-1  Started
caption: depends_on controls this start order -- db, then api, then web.

steps.label: Service discovery
steps.sub: api reaches db by the hostname 'db' -- Compose's default network resolves service names

steps.label: depends_on
steps.sub: guarantees start order only, not that the dependency is actually ready yet

steps.label: db-data volume
steps.sub: keeps Postgres's data on disk, independent of the db container's own lifecycle

subtitle: Closing the gap between 'started' and 'actually ready.'
